generatedCommentsNodes.comment: These test methods use `allocate(8).asReadOnlyBuffer()`, which returns a `ReadOnlyByteBuffer` and not a `ByteBuf`. This might cause issues if the `buffer()` method expects a `ByteBuf` that is not read-only. Ensure that `buffer()` can handle `ReadOnlyByteBuffer` or adjust the allocation to return a `ByteBuf`.
The test method `testDuplicateSliceRelease` is incorrectly calling `buf.duplicate().duplicate()` instead of `buf.duplicate().slice()`. This will not test the intended functionality.

review_comment: The reason why read-only ByteBuffers are needed in the SslHandler use case is to avoid mutating the buffer. JDK's SSLEngine will mutate the input buffer with an in-place encryption reusing the input buffer unless the buffer is read-only. The support for read-only ByteBuffers in JDK's SSLEngine was added as a result of a bug reported by @chrisvest, more details in comment https://github.com/netty/netty/issues/14069#issuecomment-2129279047 .
